title: Fuobe Animation · keyframes in, the in-betweens drawn, one animation
description: Keyframe in-betweening: your keyframes of one drawn character in local/animation/ (key1.png … key5.png: the same character in five poses, one shape, a plain background). On your GPU Fuobe Animation runs every gap in one graph on one set of Wan 2.2 I2V 14B fp8 loaders: AniSora 3.2 on the high-noise expert, the lightx2v 4-step LoRA on the low-noise expert, 4 steps at CFG 1, shift 5, each gap's own length (4n + 1, 17-81 frames) and every-Nth selection, played at 24 fps (or 16 fps, true time). In the cloud each gap is one fal Wan 2.2 A14B image-to-video clip with an end frame and AniSora on the high-noise expert, every frame kept at 16 fps, joined. Hardware: Wan 2.2 14B fp8 with two experts needs about 24 GB of VRAM at 720p (the manifest's vramGb); each pass holds its own frames, and system RAM for the decoded frames grows with the total length (the workflow's 116 made frames at 1280x720 are about 1 GB of float frames). Demo mode returns the demo provider's clip. Metrics: temporal steadiness, identity of the drawn character against key1 (expected lower than for photos), CLIP against the words. The words are Fuobe's own.
